features.covered_by: plan_get CHK-001 records the boundary: pre-DONE recovery may merge main, refresh stale evidence, and rerun validation; version bump, package sync, dist build, and experience cache refresh stay post-DONE. done-oracle hints say merge main happens before final evidence refresh and do not move post-DONE material mutations into readiness.

features.covered_by: done-oracle routes evidence-freshness, done-required-validation, and branch-synced-main blocking hints to lattice done_prepare with mergeMain, refreshStale, and validate enabled. done-closure maps the same ordering-sensitive blockers to the host-neutral done_prepare nextCommand while leaving unrelated blockers on validate/status/bug commands.

done-prepare-smoke adds DONE recovery hints route ordering-sensitive blockers through done_prepare, covering a main-ahead story with missing DONE-required evidence and asserting branch sync no longer emits raw git merge main as the primary guidance. The smoke also checks the done closure runbook nextCommand for branch-synced-main and done-required-validation.

plan_get CHK-004 permits docs or diagnostics only where behavior changes and requires host-neutral Lattice workflow wording. done-closure updates runbook nextCommand output to lattice done_prepare without Codex/Claude host assumptions. done-oracle user-facing hints describe ordered done_prepare recovery in host-neutral Lattice terms.
features.excluded_by: No markdown doc edit is required by the current plan because the behavior change is represented in diagnostics/runbook output and CHK-004 says docs or diagnostics only where behavior changes.
